pharma.title: CDSCO to launch first phase of end-to-end digital drug regulatory platform within 18 months: DCGI
pharma.summary: The Central Drugs Standard Control Organisation (CDSCO) plans to roll out the first phase of an end-to-end digital drug regulatory platform within 18 months. This initiative aims to streamline regulatory processes and improve transparency across pharmaceutical oversight.

pharma.title: Eisai launches Alzheimer's drug Leqembi in India after CDSCO approval
pharma.summary: Pharmaceutical firm Eisai has introduced its Alzheimer's treatment drug Leqembi in India. The launch follows official regulatory approval granted by the CDSCO.

pharma.title: CDSCO proposes to ban “Same Brand, Different Drug” practice
pharma.summary: CDSCO has proposed a ban on marketing different drug formulations under the same brand name. The move aims to prevent medication errors and protect patient safety.

pharma.title: NPPA caps prices of 39 new medicines while panel seeks review of price control scope
pharma.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority (NPPA) has fixed price caps for 39 newly added medicines. Meanwhile, a parliamentary panel highlighted that around 82% of medicines in India currently remain outside direct government price control.

national.title: PM Modi Becomes Longest-Serving Elected Head of Government in India
national.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has officially achieved the milestone of becoming India's longest-serving elected head of government. This distinction highlights his uninterrupted tenure leading the national executive.

national.title: India celebrates National Panchayati Raj Day
national.summary: National Panchayati Raj Day was celebrated across the country to recognize local self-governance. The occasion emphasizes decentralization and empowering rural local bodies.

national.title: Government notifies new Income Tax Rules 2026 for stricter compliance
national.summary: The Union Government has officially notified the Income Tax Rules 2026. The new regulations aim to improve tax compliance and streamline financial reporting procedures.

international.title: BRICS Foreign Ministers to exchange views on global & regional issues
international.summary: Foreign Ministers of BRICS member nations are set to convene to discuss critical global and regional developments. The meeting will focus on strengthening multilateral cooperation on shared interests.

international.title: US-Canada trade talks collapse into tariff disputes
international.summary: Trade discussions between the United States and Canada ended without consensus, triggering heightened economic tensions. US President Donald Trump criticized Canada's stance following the breakdown of bilateral negotiations.

international.title: Union Minister Piyush Goyal meets International Relations Director of LVMH
international.summary: Union Minister Piyush Goyal held bilateral talks with the International Relations Director of global luxury group LVMH in New Delhi. The discussion centered on business partnerships and commercial investments.

economy.title: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.25%, projects real GDP growth at 6.9%
economy.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Monetary Policy Committee maintained the repo rate steady at 5.25% amid global economic uncertainties. RBI has projected real GDP growth for the current fiscal year at 6.9%.

economy.title: India's Manufacturing PMI hits a 5-year low
economy.summary: India's Manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) dropped to its lowest level in five years. The economic indicator reflects a slowing expansion pace in industrial and factory output.

economy.title: Report outlines 20 key reforms for India to reach $20 Trillion Economy by 2036
economy.summary: A recently published economic report outlines a roadmap of 20 critical structural reforms required for India. The proposed changes target scaling India's GDP to $20 trillion by 2036.

science.title: India and France review expanding cooperation in science, technology & space
science.summary: India and France reviewed their ongoing bilateral collaboration across science, technology, and joint space initiatives. Both nations reaffirmed plans to expand technical cooperation and research projects.

science.title: Japan and India discuss collaboration in health & medical device fields
science.summary: Delegations from India and Japan held strategic discussions focused on deepening bilateral health sector partnerships. The primary focus lies on joint technological developments and medical device manufacturing.

science.title: Union Health Minister JP Nadda reaffirms commitment to eliminate Cervical Cancer
science.summary: Union Health Minister JP Nadda reaffirmed India's national health strategy dedicated to eliminating cervical cancer. He emphasized preventive healthcare measures, early screening, and research.

environment.title: State of India’s Environment 2026 Report highlights climate risks and monitoring gaps
environment.summary: The State of India's Environment 2026 report draws attention to escalating climate risks, rising human-wildlife conflicts, and existing gaps in pollution monitoring systems. It calls for urgent policy interventions to address ecological vulnerabilities.

environment.title: BRICS senior officials deliberate on environment and climate priorities in New Delhi
environment.summary: Senior diplomats and officials from BRICS nations gathered in New Delhi to align on climate change strategies. Discussions prioritized sustainable development goals and environmental protection initiatives.

sports.title: First Khelo India Tribal Games begin in Chhattisgarh
sports.summary: The inaugural edition of the Khelo India Tribal Games commenced in Chhattisgarh. The event aims to nurture athletic talent among indigenous and tribal youth across the country.

sports.title: SAI and MyBharat launch nationwide engagement initiatives ahead of Commonwealth Games
sports.summary: The Sports Authority of India (SAI) partnered with the MyBharat platform to launch nationwide youth engagement campaigns. The initiatives aim to generate awareness and support in the run-up to the Commonwealth Games.

awards_honours.title: PM Modi receives FAO’s highest honour, the Agricola Medal
awards_honours.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred with the Agricola Medal, the highest award given by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO). He dedicated the recognition to the farmers of India.

awards_honours.title: President Murmu to confer National Teachers Awards 2026 on 48 educators
awards_honours.summary: President Droupadi Murmu will present the National Teachers Awards 2026 to 48 selected educators on September 5. The award recognizes exceptional contributions to educational excellence and student welfare.

defence.title: India and Japan sign MoA on Maritime Security Cooperation
defence.summary: India and Japan signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MoA) aimed at enhancing maritime security cooperation. The agreement deepens their strategic defence technology partnership and regional domain awareness.

defence.title: Ex-Army Chief Naravane terms China as India's main long-term competitor
defence.summary: Former Chief of Army Staff General MM Naravane stated that China remains India's primary long-term strategic competitor. He stressed the need for sustained military preparedness and strategic alliances.

schemes_appointments.title: Government launches PM RAHAT Scheme for road accident victims
schemes_appointments.summary: The Central Government announced the PM RAHAT Scheme, which guarantees cashless medical treatment up to ₹1.5 lakh for road accident victims. The scheme aims to ensure immediate critical care during golden hours.

schemes_appointments.title: Government unveils Rs 497-crore RELIEF scheme for exporters
schemes_appointments.summary: A new ₹497-crore RELIEF scheme has been instituted to assist Indian exporters affected by ongoing conflicts in the Middle East. It provides financial support to mitigate supply chain disruptions.

schemes_appointments.title: Ashok Kumar Lahiri appointed as Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog
schemes_appointments.summary: Economist Ashok Kumar Lahiri has been named the new Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog. Prime Minister Modi extended best wishes for his leadership of the public policy think tank.

schemes_appointments.title: UP Government launches MYUVA scheme to promote youth entrepreneurship
schemes_appointments.summary: The Uttar Pradesh state government launched the MYUVA scheme to empower young entrepreneurs. The initiative offers financial assistance and mentorship to nurture local start-ups.

important_days.title: International Youth Day observed on 12 August
important_days.summary: International Youth Day is observed globally on August 12 to bring youth issues to the attention of the international community. It celebrates the potential of youth as partners in today's global society.

important_days.title: International Day of Yoga observed on 21 June
important_days.summary: The United Nations marks June 21 as the International Day of Yoga every year. The day raises awareness worldwide about the physical and holistic benefits of practicing yoga.

mcqs.q: Under the newly launched PM RAHAT Scheme, what is the maximum financial limit for cashless treatment provided to road accident victims?
mcqs.explanation: The PM RAHAT Scheme offers cashless treatment of up to Rs 1.5 lakh (Rs 1 Lakh 50 Thousand) for road accident victims.

mcqs.q: Which international body conferred its highest honour, the Agricola Medal, upon Prime Minister Narendra Modi?
mcqs.explanation: PM Narendra Modi received the Agricola Medal, the highest honour awarded by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO).

mcqs.q: India recently signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MoA) on Maritime Security Cooperation to deepen defence technology ties with which nation?
mcqs.explanation: India and Japan signed a MoA on Maritime Security Cooperation to deepen their defence technology and bilateral security relationship.

mcqs.q: Which novel Alzheimer's drug was recently launched in India by Eisai following CDSCO approval?
mcqs.explanation: Eisai launched its Alzheimer's drug Leqembi in India after receiving market authorization approval from CDSCO.

mcqs.q: Who has been appointed as the new Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog?
mcqs.explanation: Ashok Kumar Lahiri has been appointed as the Vice Chairperson of NITI Aayog.
